description: Source code for a TodoMVC application using Scala.js and the Binding library, implementing a client-side todo list with features like add, edit, delete, filter, and local storage persistence.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: Class representing a todo item with a title and completion status.

classes.name: TodoList
classes.description: Case class representing a list of todos with display text and URL hash.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Creates the header section with input for new todos.

methods.name: todoListItem
methods.description: Renders a single todo item with editing and toggle functionality.

methods.name: mainSection
methods.description: Creates the main section with toggle all and list of todos.

methods.name: footer
methods.description: Creates the footer with filters and clear completed button.

methods.name: todoapp
methods.description: Assembles the entire todo application UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to render the todo app into the DOM container.
